methodology_note: Bank: residual income (cash profit less cost-of-equity charge on opening tangible book) discounted at the AUD cost of equity, plus opening tangible book, plus a Gordon terminal on Y5 residual income. Deposits are operating funding, so net debt is zero and no owner-FCF DCF is built. Same family as SRBK (residual income on TBV) and SOFI (earnings at cost of equity).

valuation_philosophy.methodology: Residual income on tangible book value, discounted at cost of equity — a bank model, NOT an owner-FCF DCF
valuation_philosophy.rationale: ANZ is an APRA-regulated deposit-taking bank. Operating cash flow (-A$15.6bn in H1 FY24, +A$47.7bn in H1 FY25) is loan and deposit flow, not owner earnings; deposits (A$771bn) and debt issuance (A$160bn) are the raw material of net interest income, not net debt. The economically meaningful question is whether the bank earns more than its cost of equity on the tangible capital shareholders have in it. Intrinsic equity = opening tangible book (A$65.5bn, 31-Mar-26) + PV of residual income (cash profit less CoE x opening TBV) over five years + PV of a Gordon terminal on year-5 residual income. Per-share values divide by 3,014.2m issued shares held flat (DRP assumed neutralised; buybacks ceased Oct-25).
valuation_philosophy.wacc_field_note: The 'wacc' field in every scenario is the COST OF EQUITY in AUD, not a blended WACC. Built as AGB 10-year ~4.3% + beta ~1.05 x Australian ERP ~5.5% = ~10.1%, rounded to 10.0% base. Franking credits are ignored in base and bear (conservative for a foreign or tax-exempt holder); bull credits roughly half the ~1.5pp franking benefit via a 9.0% CoE.
valuation_philosophy.terminal_value_note: Terminal value is a Gordon perpetuity on year-5 residual income at 'terminal_growth' (3.0% base). The implied exit P/TBV (terminal equity / Y5 TBV) is reported per scenario and checked against ANZ's own FY21-FY25 closing P/NTA range of 1.10-1.52x; today's 1.75x is a decade high.
valuation_philosophy.timing_note: Periods are 12-month steps from the 31-Mar-2026 balance sheet, each discounted as a full year from the 21-Sep-2026 valuation date. That over-discounts by ~6 months and omits the residual income already earned Apr-Sep 2026; both are conservative and together worth well under A$0.50/share.

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,014.2m issued ordinary shares at 31-Mar-26 (H1 FY26 note 'Ordinary share capital', closing balance; 3.17m treasury shares not deducted so the figure matches the filing's NTA/share of $21.72). Held FLAT: SBC (~A$140m/yr equity-settled) is expensed inside cash profit, and the DRP (26.3m shares issued in H1 FY26 at a 1.5% discount, ~1.7%/yr) is assumed neutralised as it was through FY23-FY25. The 169.1m 'dilutive potential shares' are AT1 capital notes whose interest is already deducted from profit — treating them as both debt and shares would double-count. The Metrics.csv figure 2,997.7 is basic WANOS, not period-end.
inputs.net_debt_note: Zero by construction: customer deposits (A$770.7bn) and debt issuance (~A$160bn) are operating funding for a bank, not net debt. The residual-income flow is already after all funding costs, so nothing is subtracted from equity value.
inputs.last_fcf_basis: NOT owner FCF: bank model. This is TTM cash profit excluding Sep-25 half significant items (3,780 + 2,219 + 1,109), the earnings base the ROTE path is calibrated to. Owner FCF is undefined for a deposit taker.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2024 annual report cash-flow note, equity-settled share-based payments A$139m (FY23 A$105m); already expensed inside cash profit, no separate deduction
inputs.interest_income_note: Not applicable: interest income IS the revenue of a bank; nothing is stripped
inputs.buyback_note: FY25 buyback A$291m (9.7m shares); remaining ~A$800m of the A$2bn programme ceased 13-Oct-25. Base assumes none through Y5; bull assumes resumption only via the higher terminal ROTE, not modelled as share shrink.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-21T06:11:49Z (16:11 AEST, ASX regular close incl. closing auction)
inputs.balance_sheet_source: ANZ.AX_HalfYear_H1-FY2026.txt (Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheet; NTA table line 566-574; share capital note line 6323-6336)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity in AUD: Australian 10-year government bond ~4.3% (Sep-2026) + beta ~1.05 x Australian equity risk premium ~5.5% = ~10.1%; 10.0% base, 11.0% bear, 9.0% bull (partial franking credit). Sector context: Big Four typically assessed at 9-11% CoE.
inputs.notes: MODEL: residual income on tangible book at cost of equity (dcf-methods routing table, row 'Bank, non-bank deposit taker, thrift'). Owner-FCF DCF rejected because OCF is loan/deposit flow and deposits are not net debt. First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry existed. Earnings base: FY18-FY20 statutory profit carries discontinued-operations losses (wealth/insurance divestments) and FY25 carries A$1.1bn after-tax significant items, so the ROTE path is anchored on H1 FY26 cash ROTE (11.6%) and TTM cash profit ex significant items (A$7,108m), not on statutory history. Suncorp integration (~A$745m total, ~A$400m pre-tax remaining) is charged explicitly as after-tax one-offs in Y1-Y3 rather than buried in the ROTE path.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (3.2%) rounded to the sustainable residual-income growth used as terminal g; bank model does not use a revenue/FCF growth driver
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 3yr CAGR is negative (FY22 2.50 -> FY25 1.98, -7.4%/yr) while equity grew +2.7%/yr: FY25 EPS carries ~A$1.1bn of after-tax significant items (Panin impairment, redundancies, ASIC penalty, Suncorp migration) and the FY23 Suncorp-related share issue lifted the count 2,848m -> 2,997m. The 5yr EPS CAGR (+9.4%) is the mirror-image distortion off the FY20 COVID trough (EPS 1.26). Neither is a run-rate; the model is driven by ROTE on tangible book, not by EPS growth.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are null by design: operating cash flow of a deposit-taking bank (-A$15.6bn H1 FY24, +A$47.7bn H1 FY25) is loan/deposit flow, not owner earnings. Cash profit has compounded at ~0% since FY19 (6,161 -> 5,787) and TBV/share at ~1%/yr because ~70% of earnings are paid out and buybacks absorbed the rest; the FY20->FY25 +9.6% cash-profit CAGR is a COVID-base artefact.

base.terminal_growth_label: perpetual growth of residual income after Y5
base.rationale: Underlying cash ROTE steps 11.2% -> 12.0% (H1 FY26 annualised was 11.6% with Suncorp integration costs inside cash profit; FY21-FY24 ran 10.3-11.6%). The lift comes from the ~3,500 FTE cost-out and Suncorp synergies after the June-2027 migration, capped at 12% because Australia Retail/B&PB still under-earn peers and NIM (1.53%) is not assumed to recover. After-tax one-offs of A$140m/A$140m/A$40m cover the remaining ~A$400m pre-tax Suncorp integration spend plus NFR remediation. Payout 70% of cash profit (H1 FY26: 66%; FY21-24: 65-76%); DRP assumed neutralised so the share count is flat. Cost of equity 10.0% AUD; residual income grows 3% in perpetuity, implying an exit P/TBV of ~1.28x, inside the FY21-25 range (1.10-1.52x).

bull.terminal_growth_label: perpetual growth of residual income after Y5
bull.rationale: ANZ 2030 delivers: ROTE reaches 13.5% by Y4 (NAB-level, still below CBA), integration costs roll off after Y2, APRA lifts the A$1bn overlay and capital returns resume. Cost of equity 9.0% credits domestic investors' franking value (~half of the ~1.5pp franking benefit on a 70%-franked dividend). Exit P/TBV ~1.7x, at the top of ANZ's own history and roughly where the stock trades today.

bear.terminal_growth_label: perpetual growth of residual income after Y5
bear.rationale: Mortgage competition and lower rates hold ROTE at 9.5-10.0%; remediation under the APRA CEU and a mild credit-cycle turn add A$250m/yr after tax for two years then A$100-150m; board defends the 166c dividend so payout rises to 78%. Cost of equity 11.0%, residual-income growth 2.5%. ROTE below CoE makes residual income negative, so the equity is worth less than tangible book (~0.85x), which is where ANZ bottomed in the 2020 drawdown.

entry_price.method: Price at which buying today, collecting the scenario's Y1-Y5 dividends and selling at the Y5 intrinsic equity value (TBV + terminal residual income at the scenario CoE) returns 15%/yr. Terminal value is at CoE, not at the hurdle.

required_return_table.note: Base ROTE/payout/one-off path re-discounted at each cost of equity, terminal growth 3%

sensitivity.axis_note: Rows = cost of equity (%), columns = perpetual growth of residual income after Y5 (%). Base-case ROTE, payout and one-off path.

sensitivity_rote_vs_coe.axis_note: Rows = cost of equity (%), columns = steady-state ROTE from Y2 onward (%), Y1 held at base 11.2%, terminal growth 3%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default is 15/50/35; bear lifted to 20% and bull cut to 30% because ANZ carries a live APRA Court Enforceable Undertaking with a A$1bn capital overlay, two consecutive remuneration strikes, an accelerated Suncorp migration due June-2027, and an Australia Retail franchise that under-earns peers — the bull needs ROTE to reach NAB-level 13.5% AND a franking-adjusted CoE, while the bear needs only a flat-ROTE decade like FY19-FY25.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide: SBC (~A$139m, 0.6% of revenue) is expensed inside cash profit and there is no SBC add-back to dispute, so the house/street band collapses and band_position is null.

key_metrics_reference.cash_profit_history_note: FY16-FY20 as restated in the FY2021 five-year summary (includes discontinued wealth/insurance operations); FY21-FY25 as restated in the FY2025 five-year summary (AASB 17 restatement of FY23; FY24 6,725 vs 6,785 originally reported).
key_metrics_reference.market_implied: At A$38.03 (1.75x TBV, ~16x TTM cash EPS ex significant items) the price is only reproduced by the model at a ~13.5% steady-state ROTE with a ~9% CoE, i.e. the bull case, or at ~14% ROTE at a 10% CoE.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.checks_replaced: model is book_value: P/E and EV/EBITDA trip rules do not apply; the historical table is reported for context only
